# 整体与其部分：不加前提的规律对每个世界成立，前提划出部分；有限世界中生成复现恰当退化复现，活跨越生成，耗散使有限世界归于静止 / The whole and its parts: the laws with no premise hold of every world and premises carve parts; in a finite world generation recurs exactly when degeneration does, living crosses generation, and dissipation brings a finite world to rest

## 主张 Claim

一个世界是以一类读法的关系项、其间的流与依存网（World）；空间是每个世界。两类读法的任一流与网都是一个世界，生起与止息在那里读法相同（World.ofRoles、generative_ofRoles、degenerative_ofRoles）。Becoming.Change 的规律与 Becoming.Evolution 的 Price 方程不加前提，对每个网与每个量陈述，所以对整个空间成立。读于部分：生成复现（某个关系项在任意晚的步生起，Generative）与退化复现（某个关系项在任意晚的步止息，Degenerative）在有限且活动可判定的世界中恰好同时成立（World.generative_iff）；关系项无限多时，两者各可以没有另一个而复现（World.separate，由 Dawn 与 Dusk 给出），这些世界无限由该规律推出。活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、耗散、体现与承载活动的储备，每一个都有满足与不满足它的世界（World.contingent）：它们是前提，不是规律。有限世界中，生成复现与否，都既可以每个事件都活（逐步读法中不侵蚀），也可以有事件不活（World.living_crosses）：两侧来回传递一个水平（handing），同样的活动而每侧汲取自身的水平（spending），始终活跃的互利者（mutualism），以及把池汲低的亲代（drawdown）。所以生成与退化都不决定事件是否活。在有限、平衡、耗散且生起者体现的世界中，生成与退化都不复现（World.rests）；每个前提都不可少（World.rests_needs）：燃烧新燃料的世界以无限多关系项继续生成（kindling），两侧来回传递在没有耗散时继续生成（handing），同样的两侧没有流时在没有平衡时继续生成（unbalanced），活动不是其水平的关系项在没有体现时继续生起（flicker）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A world is its relata, read with one kind, with the flow among them and their web (World); the space is every world. The two-kind reading of any flow and web is a world, and arising and ceasing read the same there (World.ofRoles, generative_ofRoles, degenerative_ofRoles). The laws of Becoming.Change and Price's equation in Becoming.Evolution are stated of every web and every amount with no premise, so they hold throughout the space. Read of parts: generation recurring (some relatum arising at arbitrarily late steps, Generative) and degeneration recurring (some relatum ceasing at arbitrarily late steps, Degenerative) hold together exactly in every finite world whose activity is decided (World.generative_iff); with infinitely many relata either can recur without the other (World.separate, from Dawn and Dusk), and that these worlds are infinite follows from the law. Activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and only what they draw on, dissipation, embodiment and a reserve carrying activity are each met by some worlds and not by others (World.contingent): they are premises, not laws. Among finite worlds, generation recurring or not occurs both with every event living, not undermining in the stepwise reading, and with some event not living (World.living_crosses): two sides handing one standing back and forth (handing), the same activity while each draws on its own standing (spending), mutualists active throughout (mutualism), and a parent drawing a pool down (drawdown). So neither generation nor degeneration decides whether events are living. In a finite, balanced, dissipative world in which whatever arises is embodied, neither generation nor degeneration recurs (World.rests), and each premise is needed (World.rests_needs): a world burning fresh fuel keeps generating with infinitely many relata (kindling), two sides handing a standing keep generating without dissipation (handing), the same sides with no flow keep generating without balance (unbalanced), and a relatum whose activity is not its standing keeps arising without embodiment (flicker). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Space.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Space.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 规律（generative_iff）：世界有限，即有一个不重复地列出全部关系项的列表；每步每个关系项是否活跃是可判定的（核心是构造性的；经典地总是如此）。 / The law (generative_iff): the world is finite, a list naming every relatum once; whether each relatum is active at each step is decidable (the core is constructive; classically it always is).
- 静止（rests）：另加平衡（Balanced）、耗散（Dissipative）与生起者体现（ArisingEmbodied）。 / Rest (rests): also balance (Balanced), dissipation (Dissipative) and whatever arises being embodied (ArisingEmbodied).
- 其余都是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提。 / The rest are statements about particular worlds, with no premise.

Ren 的原话（2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority）：“when we add axiom, we can define what is good, which is a part of the whole space generative model projects / but, if we count all space, generative, degenerative, we get The theory of evolution, or the theory of becoming/life, which doesn't even require axiom, i think can be done with 0”。计划 P22 把这读作：规律对整个空间成立，前提划出部分。作者的读法（AI 论证）：本结果给出这一读法的形式结构。整体是每个世界；不加前提的规律（变化的规律、Price 方程，以及有限世界中生成与退化的同时复现）对整体成立；各定理的前提每一个都划出真部分，不是隐藏的规律；生成的、退化的与活的部分都非空并彼此交叠。Ren 说加上公理可以定义好，“好”是整个空间的一部分；这里的 Living 是逐步读法中“每个事件都活”的结构条件，是 G0 所计的 living 的一个部分，它跨越生成与退化，不与其中任何一个重合：生成不是活的同义词，止息也不是不活。这不证明整个生成之论不需要任何公理：它显示哪些陈述不需要前提、哪些前提划出哪些部分；“不加实质公理的整体演绎必然性”仍是开放的首要目标。“世界”“生成的”“退化的”在这里的读法是 AI 的表述，名称由 Ren 定。 / Ren's words (2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority): ‘when we add axiom, we can define what is good, which is a part of the whole space generative model projects / but, if we count all space, generative, degenerative, we get The theory of evolution, or the theory of becoming/life, which doesn't even require axiom, i think can be done with 0’. Plan P22 reads this as: the laws hold of the whole space, and premises carve parts. The author's reading (an AI argument): this result gives that reading its formal structure. The whole is every world; the laws with no premise (the laws of change, Price's equation, and generation and degeneration recurring together in finite worlds) hold of the whole; each premise of the theorems carves a proper part and is not a hidden law; and the generative, degenerative and living parts are non-empty and overlap. Ren says that with an axiom we can define the good as a part of the whole space; Living here is the structural condition that every event is living in the stepwise reading, one part of what G0 counts as living, and it crosses generation and degeneration without coinciding with either: generation is not a synonym for living, and ceasing is not not-living. This does not prove that the theory of becoming needs no axiom at all: it shows which statements need no premise and which premises carve which parts; the deductive necessity of the whole without added substantive axioms remains the open first priority. The readings of ‘world’, ‘generative’ and ‘degenerative’ here are the AI's formulations, and names are Ren's.
